messages:
devin: Hey @eng-security — requesting short-lived admin on host `db-primary` to run a small data migration / sample extract for a customer privacy review. Need sudo to run `pg_dump` and to push a gzipped export to a secure location. Window: tonight 23:00-23:30 UTC. Justification: extract anonymized sample for legal review. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1428. I'll follow the redaction runbook and use ephemeral elevation. cc @elaine

elaine: Devin — can you paste the exact commands you'll run and confirm the redaction steps? Also we require ephemeral sudo + session recording for this.

devin: Commands planned: ```sudo -u postgres pg_dump -h db-primary -t orders --data-only > orders_sample.sql && gzip orders_sample.sql && aws s3 cp orders_sample.sql.gz s3://redwood-gdpr-exports/devin-2003456789/ --sse AES256 --acl private``` Redaction step after dump (local): ```sed -E 's/"(card_number|ssn)":"[^"]+"/"\1":"REDACTED"/g' -i orders_sample.sql``` Will compute MD5 and attach checksum to the ticket.

alex: quick note — prefer S3 over scp, good call. Make sure the S3 path has object tagging `redaction-applied=true` and lifecycle set to 7d. Update the ticket with the S3 URI and retention TTL.

sec-bot: Audit notice: Just-in-time elevation requested by devin for host `db-primary`. Please respond with approval and conditions. This request will be recorded.

elaine: Approve for the requested window 23:00-23:30 UTC with conditions: 1) Use the JITA tool: `jita request --reason "gdpr sample" --ttl 30m` to get ephemeral sudo; 2) enable session recording and attach recording link to the ticket; 3) upload to `s3://redwood-gdpr-exports/devin-2003456789/` and tag `redaction-applied=true`; 4) post MD5 and one-line verification that redaction ran (grep for REDACTED) in INF-1428. I'll add approval note in the ticket. Devin — please ACK.

devin: ACK. I'll use `jita`, enable recording, upload to S3 with tags, and post verification/MD5 to the ticket right after. Starting timer and will run at 23:00 UTC.

chris: Reminder — rotate any temporary credentials used and ensure the IAM role has least privilege. Also remove the S3 object after 7 days (lifecycle ok but double-check).

devin: Will set object lifecycle 7d and revoke any temp keys. Will delete local copies immediately after upload. Thanks.

elaine: Thanks — closing the approval here. Post the verification in the ticket and ping me if anything unusual shows up. :white_check_mark:
